description: Inventory- and volatility-aware market-making agent for the cNGN/USDT corridor on Textile FX, built for Celo mainnet (chain 42220). Built for the Agents on Open Rails hackathon (Open Corridors · Textile FX). Prices every RFQ from the live Textile USDT_NGN mid (sanity-checked against an independent NGN/USD reference), EWMA volatility that widens the half-spread when the naira moves fast, and inventory skew that pulls holdings back to target. Hard size caps, a size premium, and kill switches on excess spread or reference divergence. Currently runs in dry-run mode: quoting engine, feeds and risk checks are live-tested against the real Textile book; the maker stream and live fills wait on Textile maker enrolment.
name: NairaQuote
